# Awesome HORIZON SHIELD

> The complete index of databases, MCP servers and verification ledgers operated by
> The HORIZONs K.K. (Japan). This is the operator's own inventory, and it says so.
> Every row carries a way to verify it without trusting the operator:
> a DOI, an official MCP registry entry, daily conduct measurements, or a Bitcoin anchor.
> Listing is earned by passing an independent audit, not bought; unflattering records are retained by design.

## Datasets
- JCCDB, Japan Construction Cost Database: 65,520 items, CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21898745. Measured overcharging averages ¥830,000 padded per estimate, worst case ¥2.82M (84.9% excess). https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/japan-construction-cost-database
- JHNRD, Japan Home-visit Nursing Reimbursement Database: 33 items / 68 requirements, 54 explicitly unconfirmed, sources ranked statute/agency/secondary, CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22083722. Numbers are the owner's status.json, not recounted here. https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/jhnrd
- JIDEC, Bitcoin-anchored public verification ledger: https://ledger.horizonshield.dev/llms.txt

## Public MCP servers (official registry, streamable HTTP, key-less, read-only)
- io.github.ogasurfproject-jpg/horizon-shield — KIRA fair-price audit — https://mcp.horizonshield.dev/mcp
- io.github.ogasurfproject-jpg/hs-hearing — YAKUMO verified contractor directory — https://hearing.horizonshield.dev/mcp
- io.github.ogasurfproject-jpg/horizon-shield-webmcp — KIRA intake desk — https://web.horizonshield.dev/mcp
- io.github.ogasurfproject-jpg/jidec — ledger citation and verification — https://jidec.horizonshield.dev/mcp
- io.github.ogasurfproject-jpg/jhnrd — reimbursement rules with sources, key-less read-only — https://jhnrd-mcp.oga-surf-project.workers.dev/mcp
- io.github.ogasurfproject-jpg/hs-verify-gate — the measuring gate, measures itself — https://gate.horizonshield.dev/mcp

## Verification layer
- MCP Conduct Register (rows chosen by nobody, rebuilt daily, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21970931): https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/mcp-conduct-register
- Live register API: https://gate.horizonshield.dev/register
- Full walk of the official MCP registry (22,636 servers, 2026-08-19): https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/mcp-registry-survey

## How this differs from a normal awesome list
- Nobody adds a row by hand; a server is measured and the register writes the row.
- Placement cannot be bought; the code has no route to add or remove a row for money.
- Records that embarrass the operator are retained by design.
- Every row ships with its own one-command verification path.

## Get listed (contractors and operators)
- The only condition is passing the independent KIRA fair-price audit (checks estimates against 65,520 JCCDB items). No pass, no listing.
- On passing you get your own MCP endpoint https://p0NN.horizonshield.dev/mcp answering in your name, plus a public daily conduct history you cannot edit.
- Apply: open a "Request a listing" issue — https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/awesome-horizon-shield/issues/new?template=request-listing.yml
- Guide: https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/awesome-horizon-shield/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Falsify us
- Found a row you can't verify or a number that won't reproduce? Open a "Falsification report" — https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/awesome-horizon-shield/issues/new?template=falsification.yml
- Confirmed findings are kept in the open, with credit. The code has no route to quietly drop them.

## Embed the live measurement
- Badge JSON (Shields endpoint schema): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/awesome-horizon-shield/main/badges/verified.json
- It reads from the same public register, so it cannot be tilted in the operator's favor.

## Conflict of interest
The operator sells paid services to the industries these datasets describe, and discloses it:
https://github.com/ogasurfproject-jpg/jhnrd/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
